# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 95 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 95

Jesus said: "If you have money, do not lend it out at interest. Instead, give it to someone from whom you will not get it back."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Lend it out at interest" — the practice of usury specified
- "Instead" — the contrast between lending and giving
- "From whom you will not get it back" — the impossible repayment as the criterion for giving
